facts.text: Deborah received a letter that was written to her by a group of members who thanked her for the positive influence she had on them.

evidence.quote: Look what letter I received yesterday! [image: a photo of a note written to someone on a piece of paper]
The group members sent this to me! They thanked me for the positive influence I had on them.

facts.text: Deborah and her husband are trying to emulate the qualities of her parents' relationship, which she describes as being based on love and openness.

evidence.quote: My husband and I are trying to be as good a family as my parents were!
It is love, and openness that have kept us close all these years.

facts.text: Deborah mentioned that looking at family photos, including a photo of her parents' wedding in 1993, gives her peace during difficult times.

evidence.quote: We looked at the family album. Photos give me peace during difficult times. This is my parents' wedding in 1993.
